spans.s:
शेखर m. (-रः)
 1. A garland of flowers worn on the crown of the head.
2. A crest.
 3. The burden of a song.
 4. Anything the best of its
kind, (when used at the end of a compound.)
 f. (-री) A parasite
plant.
 n. (-रं)
 1. The root of the Hyperanthera morunga.
 2.
Cloves.
 E. शिखि to go, अरन् aff.; the nasal omitted.

शेखरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Crested, tufted, peaked.
 E. शेखर, इतच् aff.
